# Overall Project Summary: August 10, 2026

Development on August 10 focused on stabilizing the framework through critical bug fixes across core orchestration, cloud infrastructure, and UI/UX modules. Key achievements include restoring the `eliza-code` TUI functionality and implementing robust improvements to agent logic to prevent hallucinated tool calls and messaging errors.

## ✅ Completed Work

**Agent Orchestration & Core Logic**
*   Restored `eliza-code` TUI and ACP server functionality, ensuring core development tools are operational ([elizaos/eliza#18250](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/18250), [#18255](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/18255), [#18254](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/18254)).
*   Refined planner logic to eliminate duplicate messages, hallucinated filters, and unauthorized raw text output ([elizaos/eliza#18315](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/18315), [#18306](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/18306), [#18243](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/18243)).
*   Improved message routing and failure handling to ensure structured replies and accurate URL classification ([elizaos/eliza#18192](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/18192), [#18266](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/18266), [#18238](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/18238)).

**Cloud Infrastructure & Reliability**
*   Enhanced observability for OAuth credential drift and optimized agent key rotation ([elizaos/eliza#18227](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/18227), [#18191](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/18191)).
*   Fixed terminal job state transitions and optimized fleet upgrade concurrency to prevent 503 errors during high-load scenarios ([elizaos/eliza#18297](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/18297), [#18231](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/18231), [#18249](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/18249)).

**UI/UX and Plugin Stability**
*   Resolved iOS focus-zoom issues and improved branded shell loading geometry ([elizaos/eliza#18311](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/18311), [#18269](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/18269)).
*   Improved reliability for `plugin-mcp` and `plugin-vision`, specifically regarding direct tool selection and readiness reporting ([elizaos/eliza#18218](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/18218), [#18245](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/18245)).
